$comment: Ceilings for `bun harness/bench/cli.ts check`, by benchmark id (`bench list`) and metric. A gated metric with no entry here has a budget of 0. Raising one is how an intended growth is accepted: do it in the PR that needs it, add the reason to $why, and say it in the PR description. Sizes are brotli KB, set at about 1% over what staging shipped on 2026-10-23.

$why.size.cssKB: 19.7 -> 20.1 on 2026-10-23 (fix/generation-panel): the notifications panel's close-into-the-button keyframes, the top bar staying in while the panel shows, and the finished rows' hover/focus dismiss X and Play touch target add about 0.2 KB brotli of first-load CSS. About 1% over the measured 19.9.
$why.layout-about-desktop: The GitHub and LinkedIn links in the About page's closing sentence are 20px tall (#238). Links inside a sentence are exempt from WCAG 2.2's 24px minimum, which the audit can't tell; set 2026-10-23 so the check passes on staging as it is. Lower to 0 if the links get a 24px box.
